title: Gold Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Gold Account requirements: $5,000 minimum opening deposit and $10,000 ongoing minimum balance. It specifies a monthly withdrawal limit of 20, daily-compounded interest, a large balance alert at $50,000, and an ATM fee rebate cap of $30 per month.
